description: Two null models (passive equilibration, strict cytoplasmic exclusion) quantified against erythroblast geometry
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def frac_mask_cytoplasmic(q):     # fluorophore EXCLUDED from nucleus
    return (1 - (1-q**2)**1.5 - q**3)/(1 - q**3)
def frac_mask_equilibrated(q):    # fluorophore UNIFORM through whole cell (passive equilibration)
    return q**2                   # projected nuclear disc area / cell disc area
def nuclear_volume_fraction(q):
    return q**3

stages=[("proerythroblast",18,12),("basophilic",14,10),("polychromatophilic",11,8),
        ("orthochromatic",9,7),("orthochromatic (max condensed)",8,6.6)]
rows=[]
for nm,dc,dn in stages:
    q=dn/dc
    rows.append(dict(stage=nm, q=round(q,3),
        pct_molecules_in_nucleus_if_passive=round(100*nuclear_volume_fraction(q),1),
        pct_signal_in_mask_if_purely_cytoplasmic=round(100*frac_mask_cytoplasmic(q),1),
        pct_signal_in_mask_if_passively_equilibrated=round(100*frac_mask_equilibrated(q),1)))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("=== Null models for the reported 'progressively nuclear' AHSP pattern ===")
print(T.to_string(index=False))
T.to_csv("ahsp_nuclear_null_models.csv",index=False)

q=np.linspace(0.3,0.95,300)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5.5))
ax.plot(q,100*frac_mask_equilibrated(q),lw=2.5,color="#4C78A8",
        label="passive equilibration (no import):\n% of integrated signal inside nuclear mask")
ax.plot(q,100*np.array([frac_mask_cytoplasmic(x) for x in q]),lw=2.5,color="#F58518",
        label="strictly cytoplasmic protein:\n% of integrated signal inside nuclear mask")
ax.plot(q,100*nuclear_volume_fraction(q),lw=2.5,ls="--",color="#54A24B",
        label="passive equilibration:\n% of MOLECULES actually in the nucleus")
ax.axhline(50,ls=":",c="k",lw=1)
for _,r in T.iterrows():
    ax.axvline(r.q,color="grey",alpha=0.25,lw=1)
    ax.text(r.q,101,r.stage.split()[0][:12],rotation=90,fontsize=7,va="bottom",ha="center")
ax.set_xlabel("nuclear / cell diameter ratio (increases with erythroid maturation)")
ax.set_ylabel("percent")
ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper left")
ax.set_title("Both null models reproduce the reported trend of AHSP becoming\n'predominantly nuclear' as erythroblasts mature, with no nuclear import",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nKey numbers at the orthochromatic stage (nuclear/cell diameter 0.78):")
print("  passive equilibration puts %.0f%% of AHSP molecules physically inside the nucleus"%(100*nuclear_volume_fraction(0.778)))
print("  and %.0f%% of its integrated widefield signal inside the nuclear mask"%(100*frac_mask_equilibrated(0.778)))
print("  a protein strictly excluded from the nucleus still gives %.0f%%"%(100*frac_mask_cytoplasmic(0.778)))
